notes: Only galaxy-based positions are tabulated (number-density peak and luminosity-weighted density PEAK). Per protocol, a luminosity peak of a smoothed map is NOT a centroid, and the A1240S BCG position is not given in this paper, so S may be unavailable under the strict rule (analyst decision). Neither the WL mass-peak position (I) nor the X-ray peak position (G) is given numerically, nor any I-G/I-S separation in arcsec/kpc; only qualitative statements ('good spatial agreement', 'co-located'). §3.1.2 says 'the 2D density peak coordinates, redshift and velocity dispersion measurements, and their bootstrapped uncertainties are summarized in Table 2', but Table 2 lists no coordinate uncertainties. No instrument centroiding error stated. Plate scale 3.24 kpc/arcsec (their cosmology). Section numbering in arXiv/journal: §3.1.2 galaxies, §3.2.5 WL map, §3.2.6 masses; 'Fig. 5' of the pointer is the size-magnitude diagram here; the relevant figures are Fig. 6 (galaxy maps) and Fig. 10 (mass map).
